title: Music appreciation in schools and Goodwin's son
summary: Goodwin urges teaching appreciation, and Smith notes Goodwin's son is a music major at Missouri.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Talking about my children and grandchildren

blocks.x: You mean study music appreciation? Well many schools of course have those courses, Crook.
Right, but I don't think it's expressed enough, you know, because --
Well, it's an elective subject, it's not a required subject.
That's right, but this is the way I started my kid up, you know. I wanted him to be --
And here he is in his next to last

year majoring in music at the University of Missouri. Boy it's a long, long way, isn't it? It seems like yesterday he was banging around on my piano; a little kid playing -- what was it, I forget, I got it on tape years ago when he was a little boy.
